status: declared before the final report was written
what_changed: prereg.json's decision rule required 0 entries passing the discharge screen. A development run of the screen showed that the marker screen alone flags exactly one entry (T-401) because that entry's assertion is a status statement that quotes the C2 conclusion while reporting that no theorem proves it. The prereg did not name a post-screen adjudication rule for such a screened positive.
added_rule: Every entry that passes the four-marker screen is adjudicated by a fixed reason-code rule BEFORE it can count as discharging: NEGATIVE_STATUS_REPORT if the marker-bearing assertion also carries an explicit negation/status phrase ('no peer-reviewed', 'no theorem', 'not proved', 'was not located', 'remains open'); SUBCLASS_RESTRICTED if the assertion names a symmetry/subclass restriction and lacks asymptotic flatness; MATTER_MODEL_OR_NON_VACUUM if it names a matter model or non-vacuum setting; otherwise UNRESOLVED_DISCHARGE_CANDIDATE and it IS counted as discharging (fail-closed).
disclosure: The raw screened-positive count is reported separately from the adjudicated discharge count in the report (n_screened_positive_raw vs n_discharging_after_adjudication), so a reader who rejects the adjudication rule can read the un-suppressed number.
control_change: CTL-3 is implemented as an explicit field-scope fixture: the discharging sentence placed only in does_not_imply must screen as false.
nothing_else_changed: Pins, sets, marker definitions, mention-exclusion reasons and falsifiers are unchanged from prereg.json.
